summary: Iter 345 retest of iter344 fixes. FIX 1 (Babel data-testid plugin): PASS — every requested testid on /contact/new (input-first-name, input-last-name, input-phone, new-contact-voice-btn, new-contact-more-details, new-contact-done, new-contact-cancel, new-contact-header) resolves via [data-testid="..."]; after tapping More details all 13 expanded testids resolve (input-email, input-vehicle, new-contact-referral, input-notes, new-contact-add-tag, input-address-street/city/state/zip, new-contact-date-birthday/anniversary/date_sold, new-contact-photo). Filled QA/Retest/5005550198 via testid selectors, Save enabled (aria-disabled=null), Save landed on /contact/6ab09687ed0731c21647d1d1; typing existing 5005550198 on a fresh /contact/new triggered duplicate-match-banner. Contact deleted via DELETE /api/contacts/{uid}/{cid} with Bearer token (HTTP 200). FIX 2 (overdue parity): backend GET /api/tasks/69a0b7095fddcede09591667/summary now returns overdue=42 (was 38 in iter344). touchpoints-count-overdue reads '42', Tasks screen segment reads 'Overdue 42' and section content matches. Regression sweep as forest passed: /home has home-fab + avatar-button, /contacts has contacts-view-switch + avatar-button, tapping tab-inbox/tab-tasks/tab-jessi navigates without errors, all three touchpoints segments (today/overdue/upcoming) click through, avatar-button opens account-sheet, account-item-tools navigates to /more, tools-back present and returns, /touchpoints/performance renders sold-this-month-card, contact detail /contact/{id} renders. No pageerror, no dataSet/testID/'Invalid DOM property' console errors. Manager role login (qa-manager@invalid.imonsocial.test / Manager123!): MANAGE section fully renders with all 8 items (team/reports/campaigns/templates/inboxes/reviews/automations/store) plus account-item-tools whose label reads 'All tools' and opens /more with Team folder visible in the grid. INTERNAL items correctly absent (admin/orgs/pending/shops/testlab all null). HOWEVER — the base ACCOUNT items (My Profile & Card, My Numbers, My VA, Notifications, Settings) are ALL visible in the manager's account sheet (rects w=1238 h~50, above the MANAGE header). Spec explicitly requires 'NO ACCOUNT or INTERNAL section' for manager. Section HEADER text 'ACCOUNT' is not rendered (only 'MANAGE' shows), but the 5 items themselves are rendered and testids resolve, which violates the spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Manager role sees the ACCOUNT-section items (account-item-profile / -numbers / -va / -notifications / -settings) at the top of the account sheet, above MANAGE. Spec for manager says: 'shows the MANAGE section ... but NO ACCOUNT or INTERNAL section'. The 'ACCOUNT' text header is NOT rendered (only 'MANAGE' is), but the 5 items ARE rendered and visible (verified: getBoundingClientRect w=1238, h~50, display=flex). Either strip these items for role=manager or the spec needs to be reinterpreted as 'no ACCOUNT header'.

The five bottom tabs do not carry data-testid attributes on this build (DOM sweep returned zero testids matching /tab-/ and no tab-tasks-badge). Tab clicks by data-testid still work because tab-inbox/tab-tasks/tab-jessi do resolve individually (spot check passed), but there is NO tab-tasks-badge testid so the overdue count on the badge cannot be programmatically asserted from tests. Recommend adding data-testid="tab-tasks-badge" to the red count node so the four-way parity claim can be verified.

During this retest Home's next-move-label read 'Reply Now New' (not 'Clear 42 overdue tasks'), so the third parity data point requested by the spec (Home hero label = 42) could not be visually verified. This is the nextMove priority picking a reply action over the overdue-clear action — presumably by design — but it means the requested parity assertion 'Home Clear N overdue tasks == 42' is not observable until you skip past the reply prompt. Not a fix request, just a note that iter344 saw 'Clear 38 overdue tasks' because there were no unreplied messages at the time.

action_items: Update AccountSheet.tsx buildAccountSections so role=='manager' omits the account-item-profile / -numbers / -va / -notifications / -settings items (or confirm spec meant only 'no ACCOUNT header'). Currently the 5 items still render above MANAGE for QA Manager.
Add data-testid="tab-tasks-badge" to the red overdue count on the Tasks bottom-tab so the parity claim (badge==summary.overdue==42) is testable from Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: babel-plugin-testid.js is working — every RN-Web TextInput/TouchableOpacity in /contact/new now exposes data-testid on the host DOM node, confirmed by [data-testid=...] queries. The two-iteration recurring bug is closed.
Backend /api/tasks/{uid}/summary now counts snoozed as overdue (overdue=42 matches pending_today=42). Touchpoints segment count and section header both agree at 42.

AccountSheet role gating: manager path leaves the base rep items in place. Since super_admin also shows them, buildAccountSections likely appends role-specific items rather than replacing the base — for pure 'manager' role the base should be dropped per this spec.
Missing tab-tasks-badge testid means end-to-end parity between tab badge / summary.overdue / touchpoints-count-overdue / Home hero can only be checked 3 of 4 ways from tests.

success_rate.frontend: ~95%: FIX 1 fully passes (21/21 testids); FIX 2 backend + Tasks screen parity confirmed; regression sweep clean (no red screen, no console errors); manager sheet has one spec deviation on ACCOUNT-item visibility

rca of the issue: AccountSheet.tsx likely composes sections as [account_base, ...roleSections]; for manager role it should slice off account_base or gate it behind a role check. Fix example: `if (role==='manager') return [manageSection, toolsSection, helpSection];` — currently the base is prepended for all authenticated users.
